name: Retrieve scientific literature and obscure facts
description: Users inquired about specific scientific research findings, protocols, and mechanisms across diverse biomedical and chemical fields, including immunology, microbiology, and pharmacology. Many requests also involved gathering curated lists of obscure or interesting science facts from existing literature, with some users providing feedback to refine the novelty or sourcing of the content.
